label: PROTOTYPE_ONLY_NOT_DURABLE
purpose: Show that the fault-injection tests fail when the guard they target is removed, so they are not passing for an unrelated reason.
method: Each guard was temporarily replaced with an always-false condition in a scratch copy of the tree, the fault-injection suite was rerun, and the original file was restored from a backup before the next probe. No mutated file was committed.

probes.note: Only one of the two symlink tests fails. test_symlinked_directory_is_refused still passes because a symlinked directory is independently caught by the regular-file check. Recorded rather than hidden: that test is guarded twice.

probes.mutation: if missing or unexpected or mismatched: -> if False:

probes.guard: destination containment and traversal guards in publish.retrieve_archive

limitation: Four guards were probed, not all thirty-four. This is a spot check on the guards most likely to be silently non-load-bearing, not exhaustive mutation coverage.
